item.description: The tags attribute is defined as a class attribute instead of an instance attribute, causing all instances to share the same tag set. This leads to test failures where tags return empty sets instead of expected values.
item.contract: Change the tags attribute from a class attribute to an instance attribute initialized in __init__ method to ensure each instance maintains its own tag set.
item.acceptance: test_config_base_config_parse_text should pass - verifying that tags are properly assigned and not returning empty sets.

item.description: The NotifyGnome class does not properly initialize the asset attribute inherited from NotifyBase, causing AttributeError when accessing .asset property in tests.
item.contract: Ensure NotifyGnome properly initializes the asset attribute by calling super().__init__(**kwargs) and ensuring the asset is correctly assigned during initialization.
item.acceptance: test_config_file should pass - verifying that NotifyGnome object has the asset attribute accessible.

item.description: The base NotifyBase class __init__ method has a premature return when plugin is disabled, preventing proper initialization of instance attributes like asset and tags.
item.contract: Modify the NotifyBase.__init__ method to ensure all instance attributes are properly initialized even when the plugin is disabled, or ensure proper handling of disabled plugins.
item.acceptance: Both failing tests should pass after implementing the fix for asset and tags initialization.
